text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option a 15.0 to 15.8 s. First overhead framing until 15.2 with the car sliding slightly left and tilting. At 15.4 cut to a second overhead framing with a different bank: an oak crown and pale ledge at upper left, the car smaller at right on the water edge. By 15.6 to 15.8 the car moves up and left into the current, rotates and grows, with foam at its rear, a dark shadow under its lower side and thin curved wake lines behind. Stripes stay thick and edge to edge. A short curved stroke is visible near the right end of the upper stripe at 15.6. Crown sits below the chip with a small gap; car remains above the caption box.
